observation.command: cd /workspace/project && echo "=== isi ~/.openhands ==="; find ~/.openhands -maxdepth 2 -type f 2>/dev/null | head -20; echo; echo "=== cache/profiles ==="; ls -la ~/.openhands/cache ~/.openhands/profiles 2>/dev/null; echo; echo "=== cari settings/config OpenHands ==="; find / -maxdepth 6 \( -name "settings.json" -o -name "config.toml" -o -name "*.oh-config*" \) 2>/dev/null | grep -iE "openhands|agent" | head
